verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer docs say you can "pull data from Klaviyo to create dashboards, sync to other systems, and perform analysis to keep up with your marketing performance." The headless public APIs support reading data, with cursor pagination, sparse fieldsets and documented rate-limit headers suited to bulk extraction. Flow performance reports are explicitly mentioned only for the MCP server. missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign/flow performance reporting endpoints in the REST API, warehouse-sync specifics, independent or hands-on corroboration.
